brief: What we look for when hiring engineers in 2026 (it's not coding tests).

slots.author: Nora Vance
slots.headline: Hiring Engineers in 2026: No Coding Tests
slots.body: Coding tests are out. In 2026, we hire for how engineers think, collaborate, and ship real value.

slots.author: Nora Vance
slots.title: Systems Thinking First
slots.body: We ask candidates to design a messy system. Can they simplify complexity? That's the skill we need.

slots.author: Nora Vance
slots.title: Write to Align
slots.body: Clear docs beat clever code. Engineers must explain trade-offs to non-technical teams before shipping.

slots.author: Nora Vance
slots.title: Ship Small, Ship Fast
slots.body: We review Git history for tiny, meaningful commits. Big bangs hide risk. Iteration reveals judgment.

slots.author: Nora Vance
slots.title: Own the Outcome
slots.body: Accountability matters more than tickets closed. Did they follow up? Did they measure real user impact?

slots.author: Nora Vance
slots.title: Learn in Public
slots.body: We check for blogs, talks, or open source. Engineers who teach others level up the entire team.

slots.author: Nora Vance
slots.title: Culture Add, Not Fit
slots.body: We want diverse perspectives that challenge us. Sameness slows innovation. Difference drives velocity.
